tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Slide and page background. Dark is the DSS deck's pure black; every slide sits on it. The brand's own black is Safe Black #121312 (`surface`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels on the ground: code blocks, callout boxes, table bands. Dark is Safe Black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A card that sits on `surface` (Safe{Wallet} paper). Rare on slides.

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: Neutral flow-diagram node fill (Safe Execute, Safe Module). Text on it is `on-node`. On the light ground give it a `line-strong` border, it is too close to white to stand alone.

tokens.name: node-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of a neutral `node`: invisible on dark (same as the fill, as in the deck), `line-strong` on light so the node holds its shape on white.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Dark plate behind green-only artwork (the Safe{RESEARCH} lockup, the diamond ornament) so it stays on a dark ground in the light theme. Invisible on the dark slide.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, bullets, the second line of a display title. White on dark, Safe Black on light. Legible on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `brand-tint` in both themes (15:1 and up).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: footnotes, metadata, code comments. Safe Metal on dark, Safe Slate on light. On `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`: 6.7:1+ dark, 5.2:1+ light.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Slide titles, the first line of a display title, the speaker's name, Thank You. Safe green on dark (15.6:1 on `ground`); near-black on light, because green text fails on white.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Source links in the slide footer and inline links; code keywords. On `ground` and `surface`: 13.8:1+ dark, 4.6:1+ light.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `brand`, `brand-light`, `mint` and `lime` fills (13.8:1+). Never white on green.

tokens.name: on-node
tokens.usage: Label text on `node` fills (16:1+).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Safe Green. Fills only: corner markers, the end node of a flow (Protocol Interaction or Transfer), emphasis chips. As text it is legal on dark grounds only (see `heading`); on white it is 1.3:1, so never use it for text or meaningful marks on light.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover or pressed state of a `brand` fill in interactive pages. Not used on slides.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The slide frame lines (deck master). Decorative: 4.1:1 on black, 5.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Safe Light Green, for tinted chips and highlights behind `on-brand` text.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: A whisper of green behind a highlighted row or callout; `ink` stays legible on it (15:1+).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Fill of the deck's glyphs (user, padlocks, gem) and the flow actor. 13.8:1+ dark, 4.6:1+ light on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: connector
tokens.usage: Flow-diagram arrows and connector lines (white on the deck).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring for interactive pages: a solid 2px ring with a 2px gap. 13.8:1+ dark, 4.6:1+ light on every surface.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between list rows (deck #CCCCCC on dark, Safe Stone on light). Decorative separators; the light value is quiet on purpose (1.35:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet card and table borders on `surface`: Safe Graphite on dark, Safe Stone on light. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Safe Slate. Borders that carry meaning: control outlines, `node` outline on light. 3.2:1+ on `ground` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: ornament
tokens.usage: Ink of the animated Safe-blocks ornament (safe-blocks.gif). Use it for any static stand-in. Decorative and deliberately faint (1.9:1 on black).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Deck theme accent. One-off emphasis fill or a second chart series on dark, text on it is `on-brand`. Never text on light (1.1:1).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Deck theme accent. Soft green fill for secondary nodes or chart series, text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Deny, blocked, exploit, risk. Safe Red on dark. Text and marks on `ground`, `surface` and `danger-bg` (4.6:1+). Always pair with a word or icon: it sits at the same lightness as `success`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background for a deny or risk callout; text on it is `danger` or `ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution, needs configuration, time-delayed. Safe Orange on dark. On `ground` and `warning-bg` (4.6:1+).

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background for a caution callout; text on it is `warning` or `ink`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral note or reference. Safe Blue on dark. On `ground` and `info-bg` (6.8:1+).

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Background for a note callout; text on it is `info` or `ink`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Allowed, passed, verified. Safe Dark Green on dark. On `ground` and `success-bg` (5.1:1+). Always pair with a word or icon so it never relies on red versus green.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background for an allowed or verified callout; text on it is `success` or `ink`.

tokens.name: safe-blue
tokens.usage: Safe Blue, the end of the Core Gradient (Safe Green to Safe Blue). Brand artwork only; on slides use `info` for meaning. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: guardians-blue
tokens.usage: Guardians Blue, the start of the Guardians Gradient (to Safe Dark Green). Reserved for Safe Guardians material, not for this talk. Text on it is white (17:1).

styles.name: slide-display
styles.usage: Title slide and Thank You. 40pt in the deck. Two lines at most, centered.

styles.name: slide-name
styles.usage: Speaker name on the speaker slide, in `heading`. 24pt in the deck.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Every content slide's title, centered at the top, in `heading`. 20pt in the deck.

styles.name: slide-role
styles.usage: Speaker role under the name, in `ink`. 16pt in the deck.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: List rows and any running text on a slide, in `ink`. 14pt in the deck; one line per row.

styles.name: slide-caption
styles.usage: Diagram captions that name a row or lane. 12pt in the deck.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Footer source links and social handles, in `link`. 10pt in the deck and the smallest text a slide may carry.

styles.name: slide-node
styles.usage: Labels inside flow nodes, Regular weight, in `on-node` or `on-brand`. 10pt in the deck.

styles.name: slide-code
styles.usage: Solidity or calldata on a slide. Keep a block to 12 lines and 72 characters a line.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title in a doc or web page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Small, concise logic which can be tested, audited and formally verified.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Time delayed approach on function call allowance.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrow label above a heading. Set it in uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, addresses, selectors in docs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to handle in the social row; small padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Flow: gap between a node and its arrow; icon to text in an icon list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Flow: caption to its row; code block vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gem icons to Thank You; name block to lockup; code block side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Social icon size.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Ruled list: inset of the dash marker.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large gaps between grouped blocks.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Same value as the frame inset; section padding in docs.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between social items.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Reserved step.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between two flows on one diagram slide.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Corner markers, the frame, photos. The deck is square except for flow nodes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and inline code backgrounds.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Safe{Wallet} default: buttons and inputs on web pages.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Code blocks and callouts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards on web pages.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Flow-diagram nodes (the deck's rounded rectangle at 292 × 155).

slide.note: Geometry of the 1920 × 1080 slide canvas, measured from the DSS deck (10in × 5.625in, 1pt = 2.667px).

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: Canvas width. 16:9.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: Canvas height.

tokens.name: slide-frame-inset
tokens.usage: Distance of each frame line from its slide edge.

tokens.name: slide-marker
tokens.usage: Side of the square `brand` corner marker, centered on each frame-line crossing.

tokens.name: slide-ornament
tokens.usage: Box of the Safe-blocks ornament, top-right and bottom-left inside the frame.

tokens.name: slide-diamond-width
tokens.usage: Box width of the wireframe diamond ornament (16:9 GIF), top-left and bottom-right.

tokens.name: slide-diamond-height
tokens.usage: Box height of the wireframe diamond ornament.

tokens.name: slide-title-top
tokens.usage: Top of the slide title box.

tokens.name: slide-content-inset
tokens.usage: Left and right inset of slide content (lists, rules, title box).

tokens.name: slide-content-top
tokens.usage: Top of the content region; it ends the same distance above the bottom edge (760px tall).

tokens.name: slide-row-pitch
tokens.usage: Row height of ruled and icon lists: four rows fill the content region.

tokens.name: slide-node-width
tokens.usage: Flow node width.

tokens.name: slide-node-height
tokens.usage: Flow node height.

tokens.name: slide-arrow
tokens.usage: Length of a flow arrow.

tokens.name: slide-actor
tokens.usage: Height of the user glyph that starts a flow.

tokens.name: slide-icon
tokens.usage: Icon size in an icon list.

tokens.name: slide-gem
tokens.usage: Gem glyphs either side of Thank You.

tokens.name: slide-photo-width
tokens.usage: Speaker photo width (portrait crop).

tokens.name: slide-photo-height
tokens.usage: Speaker photo height.

tokens.name: slide-photo-top
tokens.usage: Top of the speaker photo.

tokens.name: slide-lockup-width
tokens.usage: Safe{RESEARCH} lockup width on the speaker slide.

tokens.name: slide-footer-right
tokens.usage: Right inset of the source links block: frame inset plus ornament, so the links clear the bottom-right diamond. The DSS deck used 108px and the links ran into the diamond.

tokens.name: slide-footer-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom inset of the source links and the social row.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: Frame lines (0.75pt), in `brand-deep`.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: List rules (0.98pt), in `rule`.

tokens.name: stroke-connector
tokens.usage: Flow arrows (0.54pt), in `connector`.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width and gap on interactive pages.
